native.problem: the tool's own checker met 1 gap, a construct it does not implement as the JVM does, and refused it (--gaps strict): jdk-reference-method:java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.replaceNode(Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/Object;Ljava/lang/Object;)Ljava/lang/Object;@jdk-21.0.13 (java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.replaceNode(java.lang.Object, java.lang.Object, java.lang.Object) at java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.remove:1102). With --gaps assume it assumes instead that java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap.replaceNode(java.lang.Object, java.lang.Object, java.lang.Object) returns a new object, never null: it throws nothing and changes neither its receiver nor its arguments, and the verdict names the assumption
